description: Rear bumper damage in grocery store parking lot.
adjuster_notes: 2026-06-15 | Claimant reports being rear-ended on June 14 at the Maple St. lot. Other driver admitted fault, police report attached.
2026-06-16 | Inspection confirms damage consistent with claimant account. No injuries reported. Photos match the described scene.

description: Burst pipe under kitchen sink, water damage to floor and cabinets.
adjuster_notes: 2026-06-03 | Pipe failed overnight on June 2. Plumber invoice attached. Damage matches statement.
2026-06-05 | Moisture readings consistent with a recent sudden leak, not long-term seepage. No injuries reported.
2026-06-20 | Rock strike on I-90 on June 20. Crack pattern consistent with claimant account. Glass shop estimate attached.

description: Rear-ended at a stoplight, bumper and trunk damage.
adjuster_notes: 2026-05-29 | Collision occurred May 28 at 5th and Main. Police report and witness statement corroborate.
2026-05-31 | Claimant reported minor stiffness at scene, resolved same day, declined medical. No treatment sought. Account is internally consistent.

description: Sideswipe damage to driver side doors.
adjuster_notes: 2026-06-11 | Claimant reports sideswipe on June 10. Fourth auto claim in four months under the same policy.
2026-06-12 | Damage photos provided. Statement was brief but consistent with the photos.

description: Two-car collision, front-end damage, airbags deployed.
adjuster_notes: 2026-06-06 | Collision reported June 5. Vehicle towed directly to QuickFix Auto by a tow truck that arrived within minutes, before being called.
2026-06-08 | Estimate from QuickFix Auto appears inflated versus market rates. Statement otherwise coherent.

description: Injury claim following alleged rear-end collision.
adjuster_notes: 2026-06-09 | Initial statement: accident occurred on March 3 on I-95 northbound. Claimant reported no injuries at the scene and declined ambulance.
2026-06-11 | Recorded statement: claimant now says the accident happened March 5 on Route 9. When asked about the discrepancy, claimant said maybe he was confused, I think it was a weekday, not sure.
2026-06-14 | Medical records submitted for severe whiplash with treatment beginning the same day as the alleged accident, contradicting the no-injury scene report.

description: Theft of jewelry and electronics from residence.
adjuster_notes: 2026-06-17 | Burglary reported June 17. No signs of forced entry noted by police. Itemized list of valuables provided immediately with estimated values.
2026-06-18 | Receipts for several listed items could not be produced. Claimant says they were gifts.
2026-05-31 | Hail storm on May 30 confirmed by weather service data for the insured zip code. Damage pattern consistent with hail.

description: Door dent from unknown vehicle in parking garage.
adjuster_notes: 2026-06-19 | Hit-and-run dent reported June 19. Garage camera footage requested. Damage minor and consistent with statement.
2026-06-13 | Claimant states the crash happened June 12 around 10 PM on Miller Rd. No police report filed.
2026-06-15 | In the recorded statement, claimant says the crash occurred around 2 AM, and I think it was on County Line Rd, maybe further west, can't recall exactly.
2026-06-16 | Vehicle taken to QuickFix Auto. Passenger in the vehicle is listed as the roommate of a claimant from a prior suspected-fraud case.
2026-06-16 | Third claim in three months. Claimant unsure of exact time of theft, maybe overnight, not sure, approximately.
2026-06-17 | First note said the car was parked on the street; claimant now says it was in a locked garage, I think, can't recall.

description: Deer strike, front grille and radiator damage.
adjuster_notes: 2026-06-13 | Deer strike occurred June 1 on Hwy 12; claimant delayed filing while waiting for a police report copy. Fur and biological residue observed in grille, consistent with account.
2026-06-07 | Fire on June 7, fire department report attached. Origin at stove consistent with claimant account. Family of four displaced, staying with relatives.
2026-06-09 | Contractor walkthrough complete. Burn pattern and smoke damage consistent with a grease fire. No red flags.
